name: Joseph Bonora
title: Founder and President
bio: Joseph Bonora has more than 25 years in real estate finance and development and sets the strategic direction of the Catalyst companies. He co-founded Aileron Investment Management and led over $660 million in small business and commercial real estate loans nationwide, including $180 million of ground-up construction loans funded by EB-5 investors through a regional center partnership.

Joe has deep experience with LIHTC, HUD, USDA, SBA, EB-5 and tax increment financing. Through Catalyst Community Development he has developed large-scale multifamily and mixed-use projects across Southwest Florida, which is why Catalyst reads a construction draw the way a developer does.

name: Reid Jaeger
title: Director
bio: Reid Jaeger manages ground-up development at Catalyst, including oversight of design teams, general contractors and property managers. He is the day-to-day point of contact between the owner, the design team, subcontractors, vendors and government agencies.

Reid was previously Real Estate Portfolio Manager at Forge Capital Partners and a commercial credit analyst on SBA and USDA loans at Aileron, where he underwrote government guaranteed loans nationwide.

name: Justin Blackhall
title: Legal Affairs
bio: Justin Blackhall leads due diligence, loan documentation, risk management and loss mitigation for Catalyst Capital Management and its funds.
He represents U.S. and international lenders in complex financings, with a specialization in EB-5 lending.
